questions.question: You want to turn left at this sign. What are you allowed to do?

options.text: You must always stop first, then turn
Turn left without stopping, provided you yield to traffic that could pose a hazard
Turn left without yielding, because left-turning traffic has right of way

questions.explanation: R1.2 allows traffic turning left to do so without stopping if it can be done without interfering with cross traffic.
questions.manualRef: NaTIS Learner Driver Manual – Road Traffic Signs §3.1 R1.2 (p.4)

questions.question: Check your rear-view mirror(s) every ____ while driving.
questions.explanation: Mirrors should be checked every 5–8 seconds.
questions.manualRef: NaTIS K53 Light Motor Vehicle (Code B) manual, Module 5 (p.21)

questions.question: What is the speed limit for a breakdown vehicle that is towing another vehicle?
questions.explanation: A speed limit of 80 km/h applies to any breakdown vehicle towing another vehicle.
questions.manualRef: NaTIS Learner Driver Manual – Rules of the Road §6.29 (p.24)

questions.question: Pair each number with the control it shows.
questions.explanation: 4 = Steering wheel. 7 = Hand brake (parking brake). 9 = Brake. 10 = Accelerator.
questions.manualRef: NaTIS Learner Driver Manual – Vehicle Controls §2.1–2.2 Light motor vehicle – manual gearbox (p.8–9)

questions.question: You want to go straight on at this sign. What must you do?

options.text: Stop behind the stop line before proceeding
Yield but you need not stop
Proceed without stopping if the road is clear

questions.explanation: Stop/yield sign (R1.2): if you intend to carry straight on, bring your vehicle to a standstill behind the stop line. Only a left turn may be made without stopping (yielding to traffic).
questions.manualRef: NaTIS Learner Driver Manual – Road Traffic Signs §3.1 R1.2 (p.4)

questions.question: When turning right at an intersection, where should you position your vehicle before turning?

options.text: As close as possible towards the centre of the intersection, with due care for approaching vehicles
Behind the stop line until there is no traffic at all

questions.explanation: Position the vehicle as close as possible towards the centre of the intersection prior to turning, with due safety and consideration for approaching vehicles.
questions.manualRef: NaTIS K53 Light Motor Vehicle (Code B) manual, Module 35 (p.56)

questions.question: This sign shows a maximum speed of 50 km/h.
questions.explanation: R101 is a minimum speed sign (blue command disc): do not drive slower than 50 km/h.
questions.manualRef: NaTIS Learner Driver Manual – Road Traffic Signs §3.2 R101 (p.6)

questions.question: If you have the right of way indicated by this sign, you no longer need to watch for other traffic at the intersection.
questions.explanation: Right of way (IN7): do not slow down unnecessarily, but make sure that other traffic will yield.
questions.manualRef: NaTIS Learner Driver Manual – Road Traffic Signs §6 IN7 (p.46)

questions.question: Which sign means: "Yield"?
questions.explanation: Yield sign (R2): you must yield to other traffic; reduce speed and stop if necessary.
questions.manualRef: NaTIS Learner Driver Manual – Road Traffic Signs §3.1 R2 (p.4)

questions.question: Which control do you use to warn other road users to avoid a collision?
questions.explanation: The horn (11) alerts other road users to avoid a collision.
questions.manualRef: NaTIS Learner Driver Manual – Vehicle Controls §2.6 Sample questions (p.11)

questions.question: Match each load projection on a light or heavy motor vehicle to its limit.

options.text: Maximum projection beyond the front end
Maximum projection beyond the rear end
Side projection above which the load must be marked
Size of the red flag used by day

questions.explanation: Front 300 mm, rear 1,8 m; mark loads projecting more than 150 mm to the side (or 300 mm to the rear) with a 300 mm × 300 mm red flag by day.
questions.manualRef: NaTIS Learner Driver Manual – Rules of the Road §6.35 (p.26); NaTIS Learner Driver Manual – Rules of the Road §6.36 (p.27)

questions.question: What is a "combination of motor vehicles"?

options.text: Two or more motor vehicles coupled together
Any vehicle carrying more than 9 persons
A bus and a minibus travelling together

questions.explanation: "Combination of motor vehicles" means two or more motor vehicles coupled together.
questions.manualRef: NaTIS Learner Driver Manual – Rules of the Road – Acronyms and definitions (p.3)

questions.question: Tap the sign that means: "Emergency flashing light: hazard ahead".
questions.explanation: Emergency flashing light (W346): a hazard ahead; look out for other signs.
questions.manualRef: NaTIS Learner Driver Manual – Road Traffic Signs §4.3 W346 (p.31)

questions.question: What do these lines before a pedestrian crossing prohibit? (Select all that apply.)

options.text: Stopping, except for pedestrians or a vehicle that has already stopped

questions.explanation: Pedestrian crossing ahead lines (RM11): do not stop except for pedestrians or a stopped vehicle, and do not overtake inside this area.
questions.manualRef: NaTIS Learner Driver Manual – Road Traffic Signs §7.1 RM11 (p.51)

questions.question: You may give hand signals while driving on a freeway.
questions.explanation: No person shall give a hand signal when driving on a freeway except for a reason beyond his or her control.
questions.manualRef: NaTIS Learner Driver Manual – Rules of the Road §6.56 (p.35)

questions.question: Tap the centre rear-view mirror in this automatic-transmission car.
questions.explanation: The centre rear-view mirror is control 1.
questions.manualRef: NaTIS Learner Driver Manual – Vehicle Controls §2.3–2.5 Light motor vehicle – automatic gearbox (p.9–10)

questions.question: What is the meaning of this sign?

options.text: Two-way traffic crossroad ahead (one-way street crossed by a two-way street)
Lane ends: the left-hand lane ends

questions.explanation: Gentle curve (W202/W203): adjust speed so you can take the curve safely.
questions.manualRef: NaTIS Learner Driver Manual – Road Traffic Signs §4.2 W203 (p.25)

questions.question: By definition, a "minibus" carries…

options.text: More than 16 but not more than 35 persons
More than 9 but not more than 16 persons, including the driver

questions.explanation: "Minibus" means a motor vehicle designed for more than nine but not more than 16 persons, including the driver.
questions.manualRef: NaTIS Learner Driver Manual – Rules of the Road – Acronyms and definitions (p.5)

questions.question: What is the general speed limit on a freeway?
questions.explanation: General speed limit on a freeway: 120 km/h.
questions.manualRef: NaTIS Learner Driver Manual – Rules of the Road §6.27 (p.24); National Road Traffic Regulations, 2000, Reg 292

questions.question: Blind spots can be eliminated by adjusting the rear-view mirrors correctly.
questions.explanation: Blind spots can only be eliminated by turning the head sufficiently – looking over the shoulder.
questions.manualRef: NaTIS K53 Light Motor Vehicle (Code B) manual, Glossary – Blind spots (p.79)

questions.question: Match each vehicle to the colour of its warning light.
questions.explanation: Red: rescue, emergency medical response and ambulance; blue: traffic officer; green: civil protection.
questions.manualRef: NaTIS Learner Driver Manual – Rules of the Road §6.16 (p.20)

questions.question: A stationary vehicle must display a warning triangle. Where must it be placed? (Select all that apply.)

options.text: At least 45 m from the vehicle in the direction of approaching traffic
About as far from the edge of the roadway as the centre of the vehicle
With the reflective side facing approaching traffic

questions.explanation: The triangle must be at least 45 m away towards approaching traffic, at about the same distance from the road edge as the vehicle's centre, reflective side facing traffic.
questions.manualRef: NaTIS Learner Driver Manual – Rules of the Road §6.24 (p.23)

questions.question: Which of these vehicles is NOT required to carry an emergency warning triangle?
questions.explanation: Warning triangles are required for minibuses, buses, goods vehicles and vehicles over 3 500 kg GVM; motor cars, ambulances and motorcycles are excluded.
questions.manualRef: NaTIS Learner Driver Manual – Rules of the Road §6.24 (p.23)

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: 3-way stop: the vehicle that stopped first moves off first
Temporary STOP/GO control: you may proceed with caution

questions.explanation: One-way roadway (R4.1/4.2/4.3): a one-way carriageway lies in the direction of the arrow.
questions.manualRef: NaTIS Learner Driver Manual – Road Traffic Signs §3.1 R4.1 (p.5)

questions.question: You may let a passenger take hold of the steering wheel while you are driving, provided you keep one hand on the wheel.
questions.explanation: You may not permit any person to take hold of or interfere with the steering or operating mechanism while driving.
questions.manualRef: NaTIS Learner Driver Manual – Rules of the Road §6.49 (p.32)

questions.question: What is the meaning of this sign?
questions.explanation: Proceed straight only (R107): drive only in the direction indicated by the arrow.
questions.manualRef: NaTIS Learner Driver Manual – Road Traffic Signs §3.2 R107 (p.6)

questions.question: On a long steep descent, what should you remember when you see this sign?

options.text: Allow for a longer stopping distance, especially when heavily laden

questions.explanation: Steep descent (W323): allow for a longer stopping distance on a descent, especially when heavily laden.
questions.manualRef: NaTIS Learner Driver Manual – Road Traffic Signs §4.3 W323 (p.28)

questions.question: When parking on a slope, what precaution helps prevent the vehicle from rolling?

options.text: Turn the front wheels away from the kerb
Turn the front wheels towards the kerb

questions.explanation: Turn the front wheels in the direction of the kerb as a precaution to prevent the vehicle from moving, depending on the gradient.
questions.manualRef: NaTIS K53 Light Motor Vehicle (Code B) manual, Module 31 (p.52)

questions.question: Which sign means: "4-way stop: the vehicle that stopped first moves off first"?
questions.explanation: 4-way stop (R1.4): traffic from all four directions must stop; the vehicle that stopped first should move off first.
questions.manualRef: NaTIS Learner Driver Manual – Road Traffic Signs §3.1 R1.4 (p.4)

questions.question: What does this road marking indicate?
questions.explanation: Pedestrian crossing (RTM3/RTM4): give pedestrians priority.
questions.manualRef: NaTIS Learner Driver Manual – Road Traffic Signs §7.1 RTM4 (p.48)

questions.question: After fastening your own seatbelt, you should ask passengers to fasten theirs.
questions.explanation: Fasten seatbelt and request passengers to fasten seatbelts.
questions.manualRef: NaTIS K53 Light Motor Vehicle (Code B) manual, Module 2 (p.18)

questions.question: Which control is used to see what is to the rear of the vehicle?
questions.explanation: The centre rear-view mirror (1).
questions.manualRef: NaTIS Learner Driver Manual – Vehicle Controls §2.6 Sample questions (p.11)

questions.question: Which control helps you avoid stalling the engine just before the car comes to a complete standstill?
questions.explanation: The clutch (8) is used to avoid stalling just before a complete standstill.
questions.manualRef: NaTIS Learner Driver Manual – Vehicle Controls §2.6 Sample questions (p.11)

questions.question: Flag signals (SS2) are used to direct traffic in which situations?

options.text: At road works or where a herdsman is leading animals across or next to the road
Only by traffic officers at roadblocks

questions.explanation: Flag signals (SS2): used at road works ahead, or where a herdsman leads cattle or other animals across or next to a roadway.
questions.manualRef: NaTIS Learner Driver Manual – Road Traffic Signs §8.1 SS2 (p.57)

questions.question: Tap the sign that means: "Height limit 4,42 m".
questions.explanation: Height limit (R204): if your vehicle or load is higher than the height shown, use another road.
questions.manualRef: NaTIS Learner Driver Manual – Road Traffic Signs §3.3 R204 (p.11)

questions.question: You may leave the engine running while petrol is being put into the tank.
questions.explanation: You may not allow the engine to run while petrol or other flammable fuel is being delivered into the tank.
questions.manualRef: NaTIS Learner Driver Manual – Rules of the Road §6.49 (p.32)

questions.question: The driver of this car is giving a hand signal. What does it mean?

options.text: Stopping or sudden reduction of speed

questions.explanation: Stop or sudden reduction of speed: extend the right arm sideways from the shoulder with the forearm vertical and upward and the palm to the front.
questions.manualRef: NaTIS K53 Light Motor Vehicle (Code B) manual, Module 9 (p.25)

questions.question: Tap the sign that means: "Left turn prohibited (you may go straight or turn right)".
questions.explanation: Left turn prohibited (R211): you may proceed straight or turn right.
questions.manualRef: NaTIS Learner Driver Manual – Road Traffic Signs §3.3 R211 (p.12)

questions.question: How far may a load project beyond the front end of a motor vehicle?
questions.explanation: Goods may not project more than 300 mm beyond the front end of the vehicle.
questions.manualRef: NaTIS Learner Driver Manual – Rules of the Road §6.35 (p.26)

questions.question: On a public road divided into two roadways, which roadway must you use?
questions.explanation: On a road with two roadways you must drive on the left-hand roadway, unless directed otherwise.
questions.manualRef: NaTIS Learner Driver Manual – Rules of the Road §6.37 (p.27)

questions.question: Brake lights are a signal, so you should check the rear-view mirror(s) before you start braking.
questions.explanation: Brake lights are considered a signal; the rear-view mirror(s) shall be checked before braking commences.
questions.manualRef: NaTIS K53 Light Motor Vehicle (Code B) manual, Module 6 (p.22)

questions.question: What is a "semi-trailer"?

options.text: A trailer with only one axle
A trailer carrying less than half a load
A trailer with no front axle, with at least 15% of its tare borne by the drawing vehicle

questions.explanation: "Semi-trailer" means a trailer having no front axle and designed so that at least 15 per cent of its tare is borne by the drawing vehicle.
questions.manualRef: NaTIS Learner Driver Manual – Rules of the Road – Acronyms and definitions (p.8)

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: Agricultural vehicles prohibited (R236).
questions.manualRef: NaTIS Learner Driver Manual – Road Traffic Signs §3.3 R236 (p.15)

questions.question: Which steering method should be used to turn left or right?
questions.explanation: Steer to turn left or right by using the push-and-pull method (turning the wheel without crossing hands).
questions.manualRef: NaTIS K53 Light Motor Vehicle (Code B) manual, Module 14 (p.30)

questions.question: On which side must you normally overtake another vehicle?
questions.explanation: You must pass to the right of a vehicle at a safe distance.
questions.manualRef: NaTIS Learner Driver Manual – Rules of the Road §6.45 (p.29)

questions.question: The driver must always first check the mirrors to be aware of the traffic situation behind.
questions.explanation: Vehicle Controls manual note: the driver must always first check the mirrors to be aware of the traffic situation behind him or her.
questions.manualRef: NaTIS Learner Driver Manual – Vehicle Controls §2.5 (p.10)

questions.question: Which shape is ordinarily used for regulatory signs?
questions.explanation: Regulatory signs are ordinarily round.
questions.manualRef: NaTIS Learner Driver Manual – Road Traffic Signs §1 Signs in general (p.2)

questions.question: At this sign, two other vehicles stopped before you did. When may you move off?

options.text: When the vehicle on your right has moved off, regardless of when it arrived
Immediately, if you are turning left
Only after the vehicles that stopped before you have moved off
When the larger vehicle has moved off

questions.explanation: At a 4-way stop you may not move off before all the vehicles that stopped before you have moved off, and only when safe.
questions.manualRef: NaTIS Learner Driver Manual – Road Traffic Signs §3.1 R1.4 (p.4)

questions.question: To increase the speed of the vehicle you use the ____.
questions.explanation: The accelerator (10) increases the speed of the vehicle.
questions.manualRef: NaTIS Learner Driver Manual – Vehicle Controls §2.6 Sample questions (p.11)

questions.question: Which of these is a FIXED hazard? (Select all that apply.)
questions.explanation: Fixed hazards include intersections, traffic circles, lamp posts, trees, curves, potholes, rain, dust, smoke; moving hazards are vehicles, persons, animals.
questions.manualRef: NaTIS K53 Light Motor Vehicle (Code B) manual, Glossary – Hazard (p.82)

questions.question: In this manual-transmission car, what is control number 2?
questions.explanation: Control 2 is the window wiper.
questions.manualRef: NaTIS Learner Driver Manual – Vehicle Controls §2.1–2.2 Light motor vehicle – manual gearbox (p.8–9)

questions.question: The legal limit for alcohol in the blood of a professional driver is less than ____ per 100 ml of blood.
questions.explanation: For a professional driver the blood alcohol limit is 0,02 g per 100 ml.
questions.manualRef: NaTIS Learner Driver Manual – Rules of the Road §6.65 (p.38)

questions.question: When should you dip the main beam (bright lights) of your vehicle?

options.text: For oncoming traffic and when following another vehicle

questions.explanation: Remember to dip the main beam of your vehicle for oncoming traffic, as well as when following another vehicle.
questions.manualRef: NaTIS Learner Driver Manual – Rules of the Road §6.2 (p.16)

questions.question: What must you do before leaving your vehicle unattended on the road?

options.text: Set the brake or use another method that effectively prevents it from moving
Switch on the hazard lights only

questions.explanation: You may not leave a vehicle unattended without setting its brake or otherwise preventing it from moving.
questions.manualRef: NaTIS Learner Driver Manual – Rules of the Road §6.49 (p.32)

questions.question: Put the steps for changing lanes in the correct order.

options.text: Steer to the selected lane, if safe
Check the appropriate blind spot again
Check rear-view mirror(s) and appropriate blind spot

questions.explanation: LMV Module 28: obey signs; check mirrors and blind spot; signal; check blind spot; steer to the lane if safe; cancel signal.
questions.manualRef: NaTIS K53 Light Motor Vehicle (Code B) manual, Module 28 (p.49)

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: Sharp curve (W204/W205): slow down to take the curve safely.
questions.manualRef: NaTIS Learner Driver Manual – Road Traffic Signs §4.2 W204 (p.25)

questions.question: It is an offence to sit in the driver's seat of a car with its engine running while under the influence of alcohol, even if the car is not moving.
questions.explanation: No person shall occupy the driver's seat of a motor vehicle of which the engine is running while under the influence of intoxicating liquor or a narcotic drug.
questions.manualRef: NaTIS Learner Driver Manual – Rules of the Road §6.65 (p.38)

questions.question: Your vehicle is 2,3 m wide. What does this sign mean for you?

options.text: Do not proceed – your vehicle is wider than allowed
Proceed if you fold your mirrors in

questions.explanation: Width limit (R239): do not enter if the overall width of your vehicle exceeds the width indicated in metres.
questions.manualRef: NaTIS Learner Driver Manual – Road Traffic Signs §3.3 R239 (p.15)

questions.question: This sign means: "Beginning of dual roadway".
questions.explanation: Beginning of dual roadway (W118/W119): you will soon enter a one-way road; it is not necessarily a freeway.
questions.manualRef: NaTIS Learner Driver Manual – Road Traffic Signs §4.1 W118 (p.24)

questions.question: What does this road marking mean?
questions.explanation: No crossing lines (RM2): may not be crossed except to pass a stationary vehicle or obstruction.
questions.manualRef: NaTIS Learner Driver Manual – Road Traffic Signs §7.1 RM2 (p.48)

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: Height restricted (W320): a structure ahead with the height shown; find another route if your vehicle is higher.
questions.manualRef: NaTIS Learner Driver Manual – Road Traffic Signs §4.3 W320 (p.28)

questions.question: It is against the law for passengers to ride in a caravan being towed.
questions.explanation: It is against the law for passengers to ride in a caravan.
questions.manualRef: NaTIS Learner Driver Manual – Rules of the Road §6.34 (p.26)

questions.question: Match each exclusive parking bay letter (RM7) to the road users it is reserved for.
questions.explanation: RM7 letters: A ambulance, B bus, L loading zone, T taxi, F fire-fighting, R rickshaw, CD diplomatic, MB minibus, SOS phone, D defence force, P police.
questions.manualRef: NaTIS Learner Driver Manual – Road Traffic Signs §7.1 RM7 (p.50)

questions.question: An adult may sit in a seat without a seatbelt only if all the seats with seatbelts in that row are already occupied.
questions.explanation: No adult shall occupy a seat in a row without a seatbelt unless all other seats in that row fitted with seatbelts are already occupied.
questions.manualRef: NaTIS Learner Driver Manual – Rules of the Road §6.17 (p.20)

questions.question: At this sign, if there is oncoming traffic you must stop at least ____ from the structure and yield.
questions.explanation: One vehicle width structure (W327): stop at least 6 m from the structure and yield to the other vehicle.
questions.manualRef: NaTIS Learner Driver Manual – Road Traffic Signs §4.3 W327 (p.29)

questions.question: A rear-view mirror must allow the driver to see a clear reflection of traffic to the rear in clear weather.
questions.explanation: A motor vehicle must be fitted with mirror(s) enabling the driver to see a clear reflection of traffic to the rear in clear weather.
questions.manualRef: NaTIS Learner Driver Manual – Rules of the Road §6.11 (p.18)

questions.question: What does this sign indicate?

options.text: Winding road (first bend to the right)
Two-way traffic crossroad ahead (one-way street crossed by a two-way street)

questions.explanation: Gentle curve (W202/W203): adjust speed so you can take the curve safely.
questions.manualRef: NaTIS Learner Driver Manual – Road Traffic Signs §4.2 W202 (p.25)

questions.question: You may drive while holding a cellphone in your hand, as long as you do not talk on it.
questions.explanation: No person shall drive a vehicle while holding a cellular phone or other communication device in one or both hands or with any other part of the body.
questions.manualRef: NaTIS Learner Driver Manual – Rules of the Road §6.52 (p.34); National Road Traffic Regulations, 2000, Reg 308A

questions.question: Which number shows the left and right rear-view mirrors in this manual-transmission car?
questions.explanation: The left and right rear-view mirrors is number 3.
questions.manualRef: NaTIS Learner Driver Manual – Vehicle Controls §2.1–2.2 Light motor vehicle – manual gearbox (p.8–9)

questions.question: In this automatic car, which controls show traffic at the left and right rear sides?
questions.explanation: Control 3 is the left and right rear-view mirrors.
questions.manualRef: NaTIS Learner Driver Manual – Vehicle Controls §2.3–2.5 Light motor vehicle – automatic gearbox (p.9–10); NaTIS Learner Driver Manual – Vehicle Controls §2.6 Sample questions (p.11)

questions.question: When should the parking brake be applied?

options.text: When parked or stopped for any length of time, or where the vehicle might roll

questions.explanation: Apply the parking brake when parked or stopped for any length of time, or where there is a possibility of rolling.
questions.manualRef: NaTIS K53 Light Motor Vehicle (Code B) manual, Glossary – Parking brake (p.83)

questions.question: What should you do at this sign?

options.text: Slow down and look out for other signs and people regulating traffic

questions.explanation: Road works (TW336): slow down and look out for other temporary signs, people regulating the traffic or crossing the road.
questions.manualRef: NaTIS Learner Driver Manual – Road Traffic Signs §4.3 TW336 (p.30)

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: Speed humps (W332): slow down so you can cross without damage or losing control.
questions.manualRef: NaTIS Learner Driver Manual – Road Traffic Signs §4.3 W332 (p.30)

questions.question: A sign showing a lower speed limit overrides the general speed limit on that road.
questions.explanation: The general speed limits apply unless otherwise indicated by a road traffic sign.
questions.manualRef: NaTIS Learner Driver Manual – Rules of the Road §6.27 (p.24)

questions.question: Put the first steps of the interior pre-trip inspection in the correct order.

options.text: Ensure the parking brake is applied
Check for warning lights and gauges
Ensure the gear lever is in neutral ("P" or "N" for automatic)

questions.explanation: LMV Module 2 (pre-trip inspection – interior).
questions.manualRef: NaTIS K53 Light Motor Vehicle (Code B) manual, Module 2 (p.18)

questions.question: What should you do if you see this sign and do not want to leave the freeway?

options.text: Pass to the left of the sign
Pass to the right of the sign

questions.explanation: Gore exit (GA4): pass on the left-hand side if you want to leave the freeway and on the right-hand side if you do not.
questions.manualRef: NaTIS Learner Driver Manual – Road Traffic Signs §5.2 GA4 (p.42)

questions.question: In this manual-transmission car, what is control number 10?
questions.explanation: Control 10 is the accelerator.
questions.manualRef: NaTIS Learner Driver Manual – Vehicle Controls §2.1–2.2 Light motor vehicle – manual gearbox (p.8–9)

questions.question: What is the accelerator used for?

options.text: To see what is to the rear of the vehicle
To alert other road users in order to avoid a collision
To clean the front windscreen (e.g. when driving in the rain)
To increase the speed of the vehicle

questions.explanation: The accelerator is used to increase the speed of the vehicle.
questions.manualRef: NaTIS Learner Driver Manual – Vehicle Controls §2.6 Sample questions (p.11)

questions.question: Which sign means: "Agricultural vehicles only"?
questions.explanation: Agricultural vehicles only (R130).
questions.manualRef: NaTIS Learner Driver Manual – Road Traffic Signs §3.2 R130 (p.9)

questions.question: Tap the sign that means: "Width restriction ahead (2,1 m)".
questions.explanation: Width (W360): do not continue if your vehicle is wider than shown.
questions.manualRef: NaTIS Learner Driver Manual – Road Traffic Signs §4.3 W360 (p.33)

questions.question: A trailer (not a semi-trailer) with a GVM of less than 12 000 kg may not be longer than ____.
questions.explanation: A trailer (not semi-trailer) with a GVM below 12 000 kg may not exceed 8 m.
questions.manualRef: NaTIS Learner Driver Manual – Rules of the Road §6.30 (p.24)

questions.question: This sign means: "One-way roadway to the right".
questions.explanation: False. One-way roadway (R4.1/4.2/4.3): a one-way carriageway lies in the direction of the arrow. ("One-way roadway to the right" is the meaning of R4.2.)
questions.manualRef: NaTIS Learner Driver Manual – Road Traffic Signs §3.1 R4.3 (p.5)

questions.question: Match each stopping restriction to its distance.

options.text: Approach side of a pedestrian crossing
No stopping within the railway reserve

questions.explanation: No stopping within 6 m of a tunnel, subway or bridge; within 9 m of the approach side of a pedestrian crossing; within the railway reserve at a level crossing; or on the right-hand side facing oncoming traffic.
questions.manualRef: NaTIS Learner Driver Manual – Rules of the Road §6.48 (p.31)

questions.question: Where do you apply for a learner's licence?

options.text: At a driving licence testing centre (DLTC)

questions.explanation: You apply at a driving licence testing centre (DLTC) on form LL1.
questions.manualRef: NaTIS Learner Driver Manual – Rules of the Road – Information for learner's licence test (p.11)

questions.question: Tap the sign that means: "Animal-drawn vehicles only".
questions.explanation: Animal-drawn vehicles only (R131).
questions.manualRef: NaTIS Learner Driver Manual – Road Traffic Signs §3.2 R131 (p.9)

questions.question: What is the meaning of this sign?

options.text: You have right of way at the intersection ahead
Multi-phase traffic signals: your signal may stay red while oncoming traffic gets green

questions.explanation: Countdown signs (IN3, IN2, IN1): an exit about 300 m, 200 m and 100 m ahead; IN1 has one bar.
questions.manualRef: NaTIS Learner Driver Manual – Road Traffic Signs §6 IN1 (p.46)

questions.question: What must you do when a steady amber arrow is shown?

options.text: Turn only if no oncoming traffic
Stop and wait until the flashing green arrow shows you may go

questions.explanation: Constant amber arrow: stop and wait until the flashing green arrow shows you may go.
questions.manualRef: NaTIS Learner Driver Manual – Road Traffic Signs §8 Traffic signals (p.56)

questions.question: When may you allow part of your body to protrude from a moving vehicle?

options.text: When the window is open on a hot day
Only to give a hand signal

questions.explanation: You may not allow any part of your body to protrude beyond the vehicle while it is in motion, except to give a hand signal.
questions.manualRef: NaTIS Learner Driver Manual – Rules of the Road §6.49 (p.32)

questions.question: What does this sign indicate?
questions.explanation: Railway crossing (W318): slow down and look right and left for trains; stop in time but not within the railway reserve.
questions.manualRef: NaTIS Learner Driver Manual – Road Traffic Signs §4.3 W318 (p.28)

questions.question: Tap the sign that means: "Staggered junction: side road from the left first, then from the right".
questions.explanation: Staggered junction (W110): a road joins from the left first and then from the right.
questions.manualRef: NaTIS Learner Driver Manual – Road Traffic Signs §4.1 W110 (p.24)

questions.question: How should a motorcyclist hold the handgrips while steering?

options.text: Hands may rest on the tank
Keep both hands on the handgrips
One hand is enough at all times
Only the right hand on the throttle

questions.explanation: MC Module 13: keep both hands on the handgrips and steer smoothly in a controlled manner.
questions.manualRef: NaTIS K53 Motor Cycles manual Part 1, Module 13 (p.30)

questions.question: You may exceed the speed limit while overtaking, as long as you return to the limit afterwards.
questions.explanation: Exceeding the speed limit when overtaking is not permissible.
questions.manualRef: NaTIS Learner Driver Manual – Rules of the Road §6.45 (p.29)

questions.question: Which control is used to alert other road users in order to avoid a collision?
questions.explanation: The horn (11).
questions.manualRef: NaTIS Learner Driver Manual – Vehicle Controls §2.6 Sample questions (p.11)

questions.question: In this manual-transmission car, what is control number 11?
questions.explanation: Control 11 is the horn.
questions.manualRef: NaTIS Learner Driver Manual – Vehicle Controls §2.1–2.2 Light motor vehicle – manual gearbox (p.8–9)

questions.question: This sign means: "Reserved for motor cars".
questions.explanation: False. Pedal cycle reservation (R304): if you are not riding a bicycle, do not enter or use this area. ("Reserved for motor cars" is the meaning of R308.)
questions.manualRef: NaTIS Learner Driver Manual – Road Traffic Signs §3.4 R304 (p.16)

questions.question: How many hands must a motorcycle rider keep on the handlebars at all times?

options.text: Two, except when signalling with the left hand

questions.explanation: A rider must have at least one hand on the handlebars at all times.
questions.manualRef: NaTIS Learner Driver Manual – Rules of the Road §6.50 (p.33)

questions.question: When parking on a roadway in an urban area, how far from the edge may the outside of your left-hand wheels be at most?
questions.explanation: You may not park with the outside of any left-hand wheel more than 450 mm within the roadway.
questions.manualRef: NaTIS Learner Driver Manual – Rules of the Road §6.47 (p.31)

questions.question: What should the driver of a heavy vehicle do at this sign?

options.text: Engage a lower gear before the descent

questions.explanation: Engage lower gear (GS505): if you are driving a heavy motor vehicle engage a lower gear so the vehicle moves down the descent more slowly and the brakes do not overheat.
questions.manualRef: NaTIS Learner Driver Manual – Road Traffic Signs §5.3 GS505 (p.44)

questions.question: On which form do you apply for a learner's licence?
questions.explanation: Application for a learner's licence is made at a DLTC on the appropriate application form (form LL1).
questions.manualRef: NaTIS Learner Driver Manual – Rules of the Road – Information for learner's licence test (p.11)

questions.question: A vehicle left in the same place on a public road WITHIN an urban area is regarded as abandoned after…
questions.explanation: A vehicle left for more than 7 days in the same place within an urban area is deemed abandoned.
questions.manualRef: NaTIS Learner Driver Manual – Rules of the Road §6.54 (p.34)
